title: Jahangir to Shah Jahan: more people, campaigns and revolts

boxes.title: Jahangir: added detail
items: Named after **Sheikh Salim Chishti**; revolted vs Akbar c. **1599**
Khusrau blinded; died **1622** in Khurram's custody
**Mahabat Khan's coup** (**1626**): seized Jahangir on the **Jhelum**
Khurram's revolt: Nur Jahan backed son-in-law ==**Shahryar**==

boxes.title: Nur Jahan & family: more
head: Person
Fact
rows: Born **1577**, **Kandahar**; widow of **Sher Afghan**; later **Padshah Begum**
Agra; marble inlay; ==precursor of the Taj==
Hawkins: Agra **1609**, left **1611**; Roe followed court to **Ajmer, Mandu**

boxes.title: Shah Jahan: more
items: Early revolts: Bundela ==**Jujhar Singh**==; **Khan Jahan Lodi**
Taj: Indian, Persian, Central Asian elements

boxes.title: Deccan: more
items: Malik Ambar's son ==**Fath Khan**== submitted; **Mahabat Khan** Deccan governor
Golconda tribute ⚠ other notes: **two-and-a-half lakh** rupees
**1656**: Aurangzeb attacked Golconda at ==**Mir Jumla**'s instigation==
Aurangzeb's phases: **1658-68** recover Bijapur lands; **1668-84** Marathas; **1686-87** annexation
Golconda formally **3 Oct 1687**; **Sambhaji** executed **1689**; Rajaram at **Jinji**; Shahu freed by **Bahadur Shah I**

boxes.title: AP angle
items: **Muhammad Qutb Shah** let Khurram pass to Bengal; Jahangir's envoy **Mir Makki**
